description: The push and stall guard (X1, D-022, D-025, D-069): the auto-push hook, the replay-branch remedy and the session stall signal.

push-guard.decision_marker.description: Start of the line that records a decision the session took; it clears every earlier owner wait of the PR.

push-guard.enabled.description: Whether the versioned post-commit and post-merge hooks (.githooks) push each new commit of a work branch on their own. Off: the hooks do nothing and the session pushes by hand (D-022 still refuses a batched push).

push-guard.event_producer.description: Producer name of the events the push guard emits (engine.step.measured of replay-branch, the session heartbeat and stall events).

push-guard.git_timeout_s.description: Time limit of one local git step of scripts/replay-branch (fetch, worktree, cherry-pick, merge); a step that exceeds it stops the replay, and a rerun resumes it.

push-guard.heartbeat_adapter.description: forge_events adapter the hook writes engine.session.heartbeat to (repository channel). file: a log inside the checkout's git directory (push-guard.heartbeat_log_dir), so a failed push is recorded even when the forge is unreachable; the stall report reads pushes from the forge itself.

push-guard.heartbeat_log_dir.description: Directory of the file adapter's heartbeat log, relative to the git common directory of the checkout that made the commit (never versioned, one per checkout).

push-guard.hooks_path.description: Versioned hook directory, relative to the checkout, that scripts/cloud/env.sh sets as core.hooksPath when the checkout has none.

push-guard.owner_wait_phrases.description: Phrases that mark a PR comment as waiting on an owner decision (DECIDE, THEN REPORT, Daniel 2026-10-26 21:29). Matched case-insensitively outside code spans, fences and quotes; a phrase that ends in ':' counts only at the start of a line.

push-guard.protected_branches.description: Branches the hook never pushes, besides the integration branch train.base_branch (always protected): a release or production branch only changes by its own pipeline (D-054).

push-guard.push_timeout_s.description: Time limit of one `git push` the hook runs; a push that exceeds it counts as failed and is retried by the next commit (never a force-push).

push-guard.remote.description: Git remote a session publishes its work branch to: the hook pushes there and sets the branch's upstream to <remote>/<branch>.

push-guard.replaced_comment.default: Replaced by #{new}: scripts/replay-branch replayed this PR's own commits one push per commit on {branch} (D-022 batched push). This PR is closed; continue on #{new}.
push-guard.replaced_comment.description: Comment scripts/replay-branch posts on the replaced PR before closing it; {new} is the replacement PR and {branch} its branch.

push-guard.replay_max.description: Highest replay number scripts/replay-branch tries for one branch before it stops and names the taken branches.

push-guard.replay_step.description: engine.step.measured step name of one scripts/replay-branch run.

push-guard.replay_suffix.description: Suffix of a replacement branch: <old branch><suffix>, {n} the first free replay number (scripts/replay-branch).

push-guard.stall_no_push_s.description: An open PR whose branch had no push for this long is stalled (no_push), unless the gate passed on its head (it then waits on the merger, not on its session).

push-guard.stall_red_gate_s.description: An open PR whose latest gate verdict is gate.failed with no push after it for this long is stalled (red_gate).

push-guard.supersedes_line.default: Supersedes #{old} (D-022 batched push, replayed by scripts/replay-branch)
push-guard.supersedes_line.description: Line appended to the replacement PR body; {old} is the replaced PR.

push-guard.work_branch_patterns.description: fnmatch patterns of the session work branches. A branch without its own upstream (none, or one that tracks another branch such as the base it started from) is pushed to <remote>/<branch> and gets that upstream only when it matches one of these.
